skills.name: Whirling Featherblades
skills.text: When attacking at a distance, Basic Attacks throw a blade that returns to her. She can hit the blade as it returns to bounce it back at the enemy, dealing increased damage with each rebound. When attacking nearby targets, she enters melee mode and attacks faster. Basic Attacks mark targets. Marked enemies take extra damage from Skill 2.

skills.name: Feverish Dance
skills.text: Sweeps the surrounding area, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Then enters Frenzied state, gaining a major boost to Movement Speed and Attack Speed.

skills.name: Final Frenzy
skills.text: Damages nearby enemies and gains Movement Speed. Also enters the Indomitable state for 4s, gaining temporary Health. If she is defeated while this skill is not on cooldown, she resurrects after a short delay, damaging nearby enemies. The skill will then enter cooldown. Passive: Upgrading this skill increases Skill 2 and melee Basic Attack damage. The Indomitable state ends immediately if she loses all of her temporary Health.

skills.name: Shattered Ice
skills.text: Damages and slows enemies in the target area while gaining vision of them.

skills.name: Frigid Prison

We've also significantly optimized the hit mechanic for Heaven Hound, and added a new Heavenly Eye attack in the normal state, granting both recovery and true damage.
Reduced cooldown for Skill 1 and Ultimate, and increased Ultimate's healing.
